name: RC-B10-0545/2025 – After § 1 – Am 7
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the EU position on the proposed plan and EU engagement towards a just and lasting peace for Ukraine
part_text: 1b. Regrets the failure of the Istanbul negotiations of spring 2022, which had opened a rare and fragile window for a negotiated settlement; recalls that several international mediators confirmed that meaningful progress had been made; expresses deep concern that this opportunity was not sustained or allowed to mature into a comprehensive agreement, resulting in the continuation of a devastating war whose human, social and economic costs have fallen primarily on regular citizens; calls on all parties, the EU and international partners to draw lessons from this missed opportunity and to support renewed diplomatic channels without preconditions;
